evidence_quotes.O: The Zotac ZBOXSD-ID12 is a small barebones "Do It Yourself" PC. You add your own DDR3 SODIMM (laptop) memory and any 2.5" SATA (laptop) hard drive/SSD
evidence_quotes.C: IMPORTANT TIP: As with most cleaning discs ONLY USE THE CD CASE THAT COMES WITH THE PRODUCT! Do not be tempted to use a "normal" CD case
evidence_quotes.E: Don't buy an ip cam that doesn't support 640x480 (i.e. some of the Panasonic ones)
evidence_quotes.A: From reading other reviews on this page there seems to be confusion on when/why you'd use this cable.
evidence_quotes.N: Just as in previous Sony recorders I find the Recording interface is dumb.
